name: reading-list-agent
purpose: Keep a list of articles and books to read, find them by topic, and mark them read, so the user can answer 'what should I read next about X?' from their own list.

fields.name: id
fields.rule: item_ followed by 10 hex characters, assigned by the store

fields.name: title
fields.rule: required, one line, at most 200 characters

fields.name: url
fields.rule: optional; when given it must start with http:// or https://

fields.name: tags
fields.rule: lowercase, from #hashtags or a comma list

fields.name: added_at
fields.rule: ISO 8601 timestamp set by the store

actions.name: add_item
actions.does: Save an article or book to read. A URL already on the list is not added twice; the existing item is returned.

actions.name: search_items
actions.does: Find items by words in the title or by a tag, optionally only unread ones.

actions.name: mark_read
actions.does: Mark one item read by its exact id.

actions.name: delete_item
actions.does: Delete one item by its exact id.

offline_commands: add Attention is all you need https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 #ml

memory.store: one JSON file in the agent's data directory
memory.retention: until the user deletes an item; read items are kept

subagent.name: reading_summarizer
subagent.job: Summarize what is unread for a tag in a separate process.
